title: Breadcrumb
description: A navigation breadcrumb component with collapsible items, custom separators, tooltips, and dropdown overflow.

items.description: List of breadcrumb items to render.

id.description: Unique identifier for the breadcrumb item.

label.description: Display text for the breadcrumb item.

href.description: Navigation URL for the breadcrumb item.

icon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon rendered beside the label.

iconPosition.description: Position of the icon relative to the label.

content.description: React.ReactNode — Custom content replacing the label.

maxVisibleItems.description: Maximum visible items before collapsing into an ellipsis dropdown.

separator.description: React.ReactNode — Custom separator between breadcrumb items.

onItemClick.description: (item: BreadcrumbItem) => void — Called when a breadcrumb item is clicked.

aria-label.description: Accessible label for the breadcrumb nav element.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for breadcrumb sub-elements.

className.description: CSS class for the root element.

style.description: CSSProperties — Inline styles for the root element.

separatorIcon.description: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string; style?: CSSProperties }> — Custom separator icon component.

ellipsisIcon.description: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string; style?: CSSProperties }> — Custom ellipsis icon component.

tooltipPosition.description: Default tooltip position for all items.

defaultTooltipProps.description: Default tooltip configuration for all items.

ellipsisTooltip.description: React.ReactNode — Tooltip content for the ellipsis button.

ellipsisTooltipProps.description: Tooltip configuration for the ellipsis button.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null — Portal container for the dropdown.

ellipsisAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the ellipsis button.

onDropdownOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void — Called when the dropdown open state changes.
